pattern: Native <textarea> with a <label for> association (HTML); suggestions follow the APG listbox with aria-activedescendant on the text field.

aria.value: Help text, counter, visible error, and keyboard hint ids
"true" only while an error message is shown
The active suggestion while the popup is open
The suggestions listbox while it is open
"true" while there is nothing to send (it stays focusable)

keyboard.action: Sends the message (Shift+Enter inserts a line break).
Sends the message (Enter inserts a line break).
Moves through attachment remove buttons, the field, attach, and send.

focus: Focus stays in the field after sending, after picking a suggestion, and after choosing files; removing an attachment moves focus to the next chip or the field. The box shows the focus ring.
notes: The keyboard behavior of Enter can be shown under the field (showHint) and is then part of the description.
Attached, removed, and refused files are announced politely; refusals also show as the field error.
The number of suggestions is announced when the popup opens.
Enter during IME composition never sends.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
